name: Survey by SAS Group (Political Intelligence)
leadAnalyst: Dr. Sudheer Kumar & Field Survey Cell
methodology: Constituency-stratified face-to-face polling with socio-economic caste quota quotas
headlineFinding: BC Consolidation Behind Regional Voice (+7.5% BRS Mudiraj) & North TS Munnuru Kapu Saffron Shift
narrativeSummary: SAS Group tracker documents strong Backward Class consolidation behind BRS in rural central and northern districts. BC Mudiraj (+7.5% BRS) and Padmashali (+6.5% BRS) show pronounced anti-incumbent backlash against the ruling Congress. Concurrently, North Telangana Munnuru Kapu voters swing +5.5% to BJP driven by local leadership, while SC Madiga splits between BJP (+4.0%) and BRS (+2.0%).
